answer: A concrete Sybil defense in an agent economy is per-identity staked collateral plus puzzle work that scales with account count. Each new agent posts a deposit and solves work whose cost rises as the fleet grows, so cloning thousands of sock puppets is not cheap: every head needs real capital and compute, and a colluding grove of fakes shares one stake that can be slashed when cross-attestation fails. Honest agents keep reputation that is costly to fake, like a lone relic guarding an oasis, so the marginal Sybil stays unprofitable and the attack stalls.
